basis: Source-attributed LGA reports from all 20 original communiqués: prior normalized resources plus statement-specific named minerals, crops, ecological resources and pressures, matched only where each source clause names a source-reported resource and intersecting LGA. Some source locations lie outside the provisional catchment geometry and are not plotted.
spatial_policy: No invented coordinates. Each symbol is placed by client within the intersection of the reported LGA and mapped study catchment; not surveyed site or resource abundance.
rights_notice: No names, signatories, attendance, source Drive URLs or physical asset completion verification.
resource_id_policy: resource_id null means the source-confirmed resource was absent from the earlier limited S17 resource-name index. The original document and paragraph retain primary provenance.
